answer: Locks are written down in juniper, expire in opal, and tide lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 172 aliases therefore needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2883 identities would post 514 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
